summary: We pour foundations, driveways, parking lots and stamped concrete, and handle grading, drainage, concrete removal and site work across Houston and surrounding areas.

groups.title: Stamped Concrete
groups.summary: Custom stamped concrete for patios, driveways, pool decks and walkways, in patterns that look like stone, brick, slate, tile and wood.
groups.intro: Transform your patio, driveway, pool deck or walkway with custom stamped concrete. We offer a variety of patterns and colors that recreate the look of stone, brick, slate, tile and wood while providing the strength and durability of concrete. We can help you choose the pattern, color and border design that fits your project.
groups.imageAlt: Aerial view of a finished stamped concrete patio

groups.title: Stained Concrete
groups.summary: Acid and acetone stains that give concrete floors, patios and walls a durable, long lasting color.
groups.intro: Concrete staining lets you enjoy eye catching, colorful designs with affordable concrete projects. Ideal for interior and exterior use, acid concrete stain results in a durable, long lasting color that creates an entirely new look for your concrete floor, patio or walls. The beauty of stained concrete is the tone variation achieved in the final product.

services.title: Removing Old Surface
services.text: The first and hardest step. We grind and vacuum all of the old surface to create the best surface for new products.

services.title: Preparing New Surface
services.text: We apply a transparent or solid overlay material to cover old imperfections.

services.title: Applying Stain
services.text: After covering walls, we apply acid stain or acetone stain with a pump sprayer.

services.title: Sealing Stain
services.text: Once the stain has dried, we seal the stained concrete.

groups.title: Parking Lots
groups.summary: Parking lot construction, replacement and repair throughout the Houston area, from grading to finishing.
groups.intro: We provide parking lot construction, replacement and repair throughout the Houston area, handling everything from site preparation and grading to concrete placement and finishing. Our team builds parking lots designed for proper drainage, heavy traffic and long-term performance, whether you need a new lot, an expansion or repairs to an existing one.
groups.imageAlt: Aerial view of a new concrete parking lot entrance with painted lanes

groups.title: Driveways
groups.summary: New driveways and replacements, from demolition and grading to reinforcement and new concrete.
groups.intro: A new driveway can improve your home's appearance, functionality and value. We handle the entire process, from demolition and removal of the existing driveway to grading, reinforcement and placement of new concrete. Every driveway is built on a properly prepared foundation with reinforcement designed to help prevent settling and cracking, with smooth transitions to existing sidewalks, curbs and garage entrances.

services.title: New Additions

groups.title: Site Work
groups.summary: Concrete break out and haul off, foundation site preparation, land clearing, and lot grading and drainage.
groups.intro: We break out and haul off existing concrete structures like driveways, foundations, patios and parking lots, and prepare sites for new work. Working from approved drawings, we bring a site to the elevation it needs and grade it so water goes where it should.
groups.imageAlt: A track loader breaking out an old driveway beside a dump truck

groups.title: New Home Foundation
groups.summary: Structural, post-tension, pier and beam foundations for homes, additions and commercial projects around Houston.
groups.intro: A foundation is the most important part of any construction project, and getting it done correctly the first time can save thousands of dollars in future repairs. We have completed structural, post-tension, pier, beam and commercial foundations throughout the Houston area, and work closely with engineers, surveyors, inspectors and testing laboratories to meet city requirements.
groups.imageAlt: Aerial view of a new home foundation with poured slabs and pier forms

services.title: Pad and Forms
services.text: We build the foundation pad to 95% compaction at the elevation the owner requires, then set forms so plumbers can set their lines.

services.title: Beams and Reinforcement
services.text: After plumbing passes inspection we dig the beams and tie beam and slab rebar to the engineer's specifications.

services.title: Pour and Clean Up
services.text: We pour the foundation or addition with a concrete pump for a monolithic pour, then remove forms and clean up.

groups.title: Pavers and Flagstone
groups.summary: Permeable pavers, concrete pavers and flagstone for driveways, walkways, patios, walls and fire pits.
groups.intro: In the city of Houston a residential lot can not be over 65% concrete or permeable material, and a permeable driveway made with pavers is one answer. Concrete pavers can build walls, fire pits, walkways and patios, and we lay them on level, compacted ground in a custom pattern suited to your project.

groups.title: Drainage
groups.summary: Storm drainage and residential 4 and 12 inch drainage, with pipe, restrictors and drainage boxes of any size.
groups.intro: We start at the lowest end of the drainage exit point to verify there is enough slope from the highest to the lowest point, then calculate the distance, so we will always guarantee a good slope. Some projects need large pipes to store and slow water running off to the street or a drainage ditch, and we can install any size pipe and restrictor with the drainage boxes to go with it.

about.title: Decades of hands-on work in the field
text: Family owned and operated for over 27 years, Volcano Concrete has served Houston and surrounding communities with dependable concrete construction. From driveways and stamped concrete to new home foundations, grading, drainage and site work, our experienced crew handles projects from preparation through completion.
Our experience comes from decades of hands-on work in the field. The crew you see here represents the people behind Volcano Concrete and the work we stand behind.

When a major water line burst at the Royalton at River Oaks, our crew was on site within an hour, working through flooded conditions to break concrete, locate the damaged pipe and prepare the area for emergency repairs.
about.imageAlt: Our crew pouring concrete over rebar on a sunny day

steps.title: Send us your project
steps.text: Email or text dimensions and pictures of the area that needs work, with your project address.

steps.title: We evaluate it
steps.text: We look at grading, drainage, haul off, reinforcement, permits and how the concrete will be placed.

steps.title: You get an estimate
steps.text: We email you an estimate within a couple of hours of receiving the information.

faqs.a: We look at every variable one by one, because all jobs are different: grading, drainage, break out and haul off to the nearest concrete recycling facility, ready mix from a good nearby plant, city permits, completion time and deadlines, reinforcement, how the concrete is placed (wheelbarrow, pump or tailgate), sprinkler lines, debris cleanup, and sand, grass and grading beside the new concrete.

Cracking is always a possibility. The American Concrete Institute says in ACI 302.1R-04 that even with the best designs and proper construction it is unrealistic to expect crack-free floors. Temperature, the ground underneath, the rebar and the moisture of the concrete when it is poured all play a part.

faqs.q: How can concrete cracks be avoided?
faqs.a: Some steps help prevent cracking: sand, select fill or other stabilized material under the concrete, compacting the surface with a plate compactor, expansion joints and rebar. When pouring, avoid too much water; a slump of 5 to 6 is usually a good mix that works easily.
